verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say it leaves inline PR comments with suggested fixes, and each comment has one-click 'Fix in Cursor' and 'Fix in Web' links. Those links hand the issue to the Cursor IDE or a web agent rather than applying a diff in the PR. Nothing in the evidence shows the suggestions are formatted as committable diffs that can be applied directly from the review. Missing for 10: documented committable suggestion blocks in PR comments, one-click apply/commit from within the PR interface, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click

citations.quote: leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes
Bugbot analyzes PR diffs and leaves comments with explanations and fix suggestions.
Fix in Cursor links open issues directly in Cursor
